target: Full AWS production runtime with no Supabase, Vercel, or Brevo runtime dependency
method: The unchanged 21-gate binary full-AWS ledger from 2026-09-08 is used for live-verified readiness. Offline preparation does not close production execution gates. Implementation-prepared is a separate non-credit planning indicator and must never be reported as deployed readiness.

gates.gate: AWS-native image deployed to ECS staging and healthy with no legacy runtime configuration
Private managed AWS PostgreSQL staging target, roles, TLS, secrets, rotation and backups
Server reads use provider-neutral parameterized PostgreSQL repositories
Server mutations and RPC workflows use atomic PostgreSQL transactions
AWS staging data parity, tenant-negative, backup and restore acceptance
Cognito login, callback, refresh, logout and durable sessions active in staging
Synthetic Cognito lifecycle, tenant/RLS and revocation parity in staging
Production Cognito user migration, activation, MFA and communication transition
gates.remaining: Owner-authorized immutable image publication and execution, followed by activation communication and live reconciliation

gates.gate: Browser data calls are server-mediated and auth.uid behavior is safely replaced
Service-role bypasses and legacy credential fallbacks are absent from AWS-native runtime
Static/runtime provider-isolation and egress gate passes
Synthetic S3 object, authorization, checksum and version-restore parity
Production Supabase objects copied to S3 and reconciled
Production RDS topology, credentials, networking and backup/PITR deployed
gates.remaining: Authorize the reviewed production deployment while retaining the fixed $150 budget and blocking any modeled state above it

gates.gate: Production database rehearsal/final copy and exact reconciliation complete
gates.remaining: Owner-authorized live 60-to-97 rehearsal and final copy

gates.gate: Write freeze, authority switch, acceptance and rollback thresholds executed
Observation period completes and Supabase runtime/recovery dependency is removed
gates.remaining: Successful cutover, seven-day observation, separate decommission authorization

gates.gate: SES production delivery, durable feedback and human alert path active
gates.remaining: Complete DNS delegation, obtain identity/MAIL FROM verification and production access, deploy the feedback worker, and authorize one monitored-path smoke message

gates.gate: Production RDS/S3 recovery, alarms and timed DR proof complete
gates.remaining: Owner-authorized production deployment and timed restore exercise

gates.gate: GovCloud-portable configuration and partition-safe implementation pass
Public DNS/traffic cutover completes with rollback window
gates.remaining: Registrar transfer completion followed by owner-authorized Route 53 delegation and traffic switch

creditCaveat: The 79% historical figure measured a hybrid launch and is not the full-AWS baseline. No points are awarded here for revalidation or for production code that is not deployed and exercised.
